text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
The judges have ruled that first-place
finisher Mejiro McQueen
illegally
obstructed other Umamusume during the
race.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Her placement will be adjusted to
eighteenth.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The race unfolded with a great start for
Mejiro McQueen. She
navigated to the
inner track in an attempt to find a good
position.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Unfortunately, this hampered the
movement of the runners behind her,
resulting in a situation where many
were in
danger of falling.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As this was caused by the race's
favorite to
win, the public reaction
was significant.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: McQueen, are you okay?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Huh? Oh, yes, of course.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can't deny that my actions posed a
risk to
other competitors,
betraying the high
expectations placed upon me.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I simply need to move on and improve
myself.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'll put this failure of a race behind
me by
succeeding in the next.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Just don't be so hard on yourself, okay?
We can plainly see that
you've reflected
well enough on this.

text_block_list.name: Upbeat Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
That's right!
I'll be looking forward to your
next race!

text_block_list.name: Caring Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Fight on, McQueen!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes, I plan to do so.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text: Yo, anyone miss me?

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
There were a bunch of creeps with cameras
out there so I screamed,
"Look, a buncha
creeps!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Those were no doubt reporters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I can only imagine that they were just
waiting for a chance to catch
me.

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Well, don't sweat it. They weren't
supposed to be in the academy
anyway, so
they really were creeps.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
The last of them should be gone soon
enough. Let's hold off on any
actual
training today, though.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
It's not as if I am particularly
bothered by
the idea of answering their
questions. I
would do so with full honesty.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
And at some point, I will need to speak
with them about my plans to
win my next
race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I'm in the mood to move my body. Let's
go, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: ...All right.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: ...All right.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
The dorm is just over there. I don't think
you need to accompany me
any longer.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
I don't want you to get caught up alone
with a bunch of rabid
reporters.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Like I said, I do not mind answering their
questions.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Ah, McQueen! May I get your comments in
regards to the autumn
Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Why did you choose to run in such a
dangerous manner?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I apologize for causing such dire
inconvenience toward all of those
involved
with the race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
This incident was the result of my own
foolish inexperience. I can
make no
excuses.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
Have you spoken to the runners who were
caught up behind you?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I paid each of them a visit to apologize
personally.

text_block_list.name: Reporter B
text_block_list.text:
Was it your trainer who instructed you to
force your way to the inside?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Instructions from my trainer? We discussed
nothing of the sort!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
That was entirely the result of my own
judgment. My trainer has
nothing to do
with this incident!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Despite keeping her cool thus far,
McQueen grows indignant when
faced
with this question.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I know she wants to answer their questions
with honesty, and I intended to let her do
so if it would help her sort out her own

emotions.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the sight of her trying to
shoulder all of the responsibility
on her
own is too much for me to bear.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
However, the sight of her trying to
shoulder all of the responsibility
on her
own is too much for me to bear.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
But if I leave now,
they'll assume that this
was your fault somehow!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Regardless of whose judgment call it was,
as her trainer, I take full
responsibility for
what happened. My deepest apologies.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Trainer!

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text: Come on, let's get going.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Don't let it bother you, McQueen. You
were simply running your heart
out. There
is nothing to blame on you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
Don't let it bother you, McQueen. You
were simply running your heart
out. There
is nothing to blame on you.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You said you were going to put this
behind you, right? Let's put all of
our
energy towards the next race.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
You said you were going to put this
behind you, right? Let's put all of
our
energy towards the next race.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: ...Understood.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: But um... Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
I've decided that I want to run in the
Japan
Cup before the Arima
Kinen.

text_block_list.name: <username>
text_block_list.text:
That's so soon,
though. Surely you're still
tired from the race you just
ran...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm perfectly fine.
I'm ready to give it
my full power.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Please allow me to enter the Japan Cup.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I imagine that she hopes to put this
incident away as quickly as
possible.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Not only that,
but she likely means it as a
way to redeem herself in
the eyes of fans
and those she troubled.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Thank you. I am absolutely... absolutely
going to win.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Wooooooo!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
McQueen is struggling to keep up. The
gap is widening!

text_block_list.name: Caster
text_block_list.text:
Today's favorite, Mejiro McQueen, places
fourth!
